Package photos48.persistence

Interface DataStore

All Known Implementing Classes:
ObjectDataStore
public interface DataStore
DataStore defines the contract for persistent data storage operations. DataStore abstracts the persistence mechanism, allowing different implementations (e.g., ObjectDataStore using Java serialization, future implementations using databases). Responsibilities: - Maintain a list of all user usernames - Load/save individual User objects (with all their albums and photos) - Work with a workspace directory (e.g., ~/.photos48/) Implementations must handle: - User list persistence (list of usernames) - Per-user data persistence (User objects with albums, photos, tags) - IOException for I/O errors - ClassNotFoundException for deserialization errors
